explication: WinPodX runs Windows apps in a containerized guest and presents them as native Linux applications. The primary workflow is setup and provisioning, guest app discovery, desktop-entry registration, then launching an app through a FreeRDP RemoteApp session. The repository also includes a GUI/tray dashboard, host-device and VM controls, and reverse-open file/URL integration. Edges reflect README statements or relationships listed in the SOURCE INDEX; unsampled implementation details are not inferred beyond those documented connections.
